FOREST 01 — THE PAINTING
Every tawn drop
starts with a painting.
Forest 01 didn't start with fabric. It started with this canvas.

Dark skies. A thin strip of light cutting through the horizon. Treetops barely visible beneath the storm. The colorways, the weight of the fabric, the whole direction of the collection. It all came from that one painting.

This is not the forest you picture when you close your eyes. This is the moment before everything breaks loose.

The painting exists in two forms: worn on the Painting Shirt as a DTF print, and as the original canvas itself — one of a kind, never to be reproduced.
PAINTED BY · ELKE HIEDEN · 2026
